rules.description: Verifies that MaxDate is uniform across all generated StatVars.
Verify all active StatVars meet the 1-year publication lag freshness boundary (TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= year(current_date) - 1).

Verifies that all StatVars cover the expected minimum number of places (NumPlaces >= 23 for non-centenarian cohorts, NumPlaces >= 20 for 100+ cohorts where rural districts may have 0/suppressed '-' counts).

params.condition: (StatVar LIKE '%100OrMoreYears%' AND NumPlaces >= 20) OR (StatVar NOT LIKE '%100OrMoreYears%' AND NumPlaces >= 23)

rules.description: Verifies all 207 demographic StatVars (across all 22 age cohorts, Urban/Rural residence, and Male/Female breakdowns) are generated with non-negative values.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS num_statvars, MIN(MinValue) AS min_val FROM stats
